entries.Original:
Narrow the catalog to one content family, the way the in-game Duty Finder tabs do:
World / City / Housing / Dungeon / Trial / Raid / … resolved from each mob's home
territory. "Unknown" = no home territory yet (the instanced/uncovered tail); "All"
clears the filter. The catalog body groups every match under its home zone.
entries.Translated:
将目录缩小到一个内容系列，就像游戏内的 Duty Finder 选项卡所做的那样：
世界/城市/房屋/地下城/审判/突袭/...从每个小混混的家中解决
领土。“未知”=尚无主领土 (实例化/未被覆盖的尾部);“所有”
清除过滤器。目录主体将每个匹配项分组到其主区域。

entries.Original:
Filter the catalog by model family (the Skel-prefix):
  Monster (m) · Demihuman (d) · Human (c).
Human rows are painted on the player skeleton via Glamourer, so player
emotes like /sit work on them natively. Monster/Demihuman skeletons don't
carry the player emote set, so /sit won't render on them. "All" clears it.
entries.Translated:
按模型族 (骨架前缀) 筛选目录：
怪物 (m)·半人 (d)·人 (c)。
通过 Glamourer 在玩家骨架上绘制人类行列，因此玩家
像/sit 这样的情绪会自然而然地影响他们。怪物/半人类的骨骼不会
携带玩家表情包，所以/sit 不会渲染到他们身上。“所有” 清除了这一点。

entries.Original:
Become a small territorial wisp (x0.50, raised off the floor).
An unobtrusive marker for a DM who isn't physically in the scene.
entries.Translated:
变成一个小小的领地纤维 (x0.50，从地板上举起)。
对于不在现场的 DM 来说，这是一个不引人注目的标记。

entries.Original:
Pull your character out of the render entirely: a DM 'here but not
physically present' switch. Click again to reappear.
entries.Translated:
将你的角色完全从渲染中移除：这里是 DM，但不是
物理存在开关。再次点击以重新出现。
重命名名牌以进行伪装

entries.Original:
Requires the Moniker (HMoniker) plugin, v2.1 or newer, installed and enabled.
If you have it and this is still disabled, its IPC version may be older than 2.1.
entries.Translated:
需要 Moniker(HMoniker) 插件，v2.1 或更高版本，已安装并启用。
如果你拥有它，但它仍然处于禁用状态，那么它的 IPC 版本可能早于 2.1。

entries.Original:
Also set your nameplate to the disguise's name via Moniker,
synced to nearby players through HMS. Revert clears it.
entries.Translated:
另外，通过名牌将你的名牌设置为伪装的名称。
通过 HMS 与附近玩家同步。Revert 清除。

entries.Original:
Sizes the active disguise, applied immediately.
Native = the selected mob's authored scale (per-mob; tracks the model, e.g. x2.0 for Galatea Magna).
x0.5 / x1 = quick multipliers; the box and slider set any custom size (0.1 … 10).
entries.Translated:
测量活跃伪装的尺寸，立即应用。
Native = 所选 Mob 的授权规模 (每个 Mob;追踪模型，例如，对于 Galatea Magna 的 x2.0)。
x0.5 / x1 = 快速乘数;方框和滑块设置任意自定义尺寸 (0.1...10)。

entries.Original: Type an exact scale (0.1 to 10). Anything above 10 clamps to 10.
entries.Translated: 输入一个精确的刻度 (0.1 至 10)。任何大于 10 的刻度都可以缩小到 10。

entries.Original: Pick a catalog row first (a plain click selects it), then Disguise wears it.
entries.Translated: 先选择目录行 (简单点击选择)，然后 Disguise 会穿上它。
你自己。Return(下文) 把它扔掉。

entries.Original: Pick a catalog row first (a plain click selects it), then Spawn drops a puppet wearing it.
entries.Translated: 首先选择一个目录行 (简单点击即可选择)，然后 Spawn 将一个穿着它的玩偶放下。

entries.Original: Spawn a set-piece puppet a step ahead of you, disguised as
entries.Translated: 在你之前一步制作一个定型人偶，伪装成

entries.Original:
.
Non-targetable: the party can't click or attack it. Despawn it below.
entries.Translated:
.
无法定位：玩家无法点击或攻击它。在下方消除它。

entries.Original: Restore your real model + size and un-stick any animation.
entries.Translated: 恢复你的真实模型 + 尺寸，并去除所有动画。

entries.Original: No live puppets to despawn. Spawn one first.
entries.Translated: 没有活生生的傀儡可以消灭。先消灭一个。

entries.Original: Despawn every live puppet. A zone change clears them too.
entries.Translated: 每个活生生的木偶都会消失。区域变化也会清除它们。

entries.Original:
That's the Spawn tab's focused puppet; select a different roster row there to retarget.
Spawned puppets are non-targetable, so this is how you re-skin one in place.
entries.Translated:
这是 “生成” 选项卡中聚焦的木偶;在那里选择不同的名单行以重新定位。
生成的玩偶是无法定位的，所以这就是你如何在原位重新塑造它的方法。

entries.Original: Search by name, home location, BaseId, ModelChara id, or m-code.
entries.Translated: 按名称、家庭位置、BaseId、ModelChara id 或 m-code 进行搜索。

entries.Original:
Hide the rows with no name at all: the model-ID-only entries that read
"(unnamed) <skel> #<BaseId>". They're shown by default (searchable by
#id or m-code). Boss bases and instanced roster names (shown in slate) are
kept; they count as named.
entries.Translated:
隐藏无名行：只读取型号 ID 的条目
“(未命名)<skel> #<BaseId>”。它们默认显示 (可通过以下方式搜索)
#id 或 m-code。Boss 基数和实例化的名单名称 (显示在石板中) 是
它们被视为已命名。

entries.Original: NPC · humanoid character (apply, or spawn a copy)
entries.Translated: NPC·人形角色 (应用或生成副本)

entries.Original: , not in catalog (NPC, or newer than the data drop)
entries.Translated: ，不在目录中 (NPC，或比数据丢弃更新)

entries.Original: Human guise needs Glamourer, not detected; Apply will no-op.
entries.Translated: 人类伪装需要魅力者，但未被发现;申请将无效。

entries.Original:
Drop a plain, non-targetable puppet a step ahead of you,
then disguise, move, rotate, freeze and animate it from its row below.
entries.Translated:
在你前面一步扔下一个普通的、无法瞄准的木偶，
然后从下面一行开始伪装、移动、旋转、静止和动画化。

entries.Original: Pick a puppet from the roster to edit its transform and animation here.
entries.Translated: 从名单中选择一个木偶，在这里编辑它的变形和动画。

entries.Original:
While driving, fade your own frozen body to invisible — on YOUR screen only — so you
don't see yourself running in place. Your body reappears the instant you release.
The puppet moves either way; this is purely what you see locally.
entries.Translated:
开车时，将自己冻结的身体隐形——只在你的屏幕上——这样你
不要看到自己在原地奔跑。你的身体在你释放的瞬间就会重新出现。
木偶朝任何方向移动;这纯粹是你在当地看到的景象。

entries.Original:
Off by default: you can only possess puppets YOU spawned. A puppet another player
spawned appears in your world as a mirror, and its control stays with them.
Turn this on to drive someone else's puppet too — useful when helping run their event.
entries.Translated:
默认关闭：只能拥有你生成的玩偶。一个玩偶属于另一个玩家
在你的世界中，孵化物以镜子的形式出现，其控制权始终与他们同在。
打开这个也可以驱动其他人的木偶——在帮助运行他们的活动时很有用。

entries.Original: .  WASD move · Space up · Ctrl down · Esc release.
entries.Translated: WASD 移动·空格向上·Ctrl 向下·Esc 释放。
不拥有·向上空格·向下 Control·Esc 释放
生成暴民 (收藏夹 + 搜索)

entries.Original: Type to search the rest of the catalog.
entries.Translated: 键入搜索目录的其余部分。

entries.Original: Click to select for the per-puppet Apply.
entries.Translated: 点击选择为每个玩偶应用。

entries.Original: Be present in the world to disguise.
entries.Translated: 在世界上存在以伪装自己。
生成一个穿着无法瞄准的玩偶

entries.Original: Be present in the world to spawn.
entries.Translated: 存在于这个世界上，孕育后代。

entries.Original:
Drive this puppet with WASD from an orbit camera.
Space up · Ctrl down · Esc release.
entries.Translated:
将这个 WASD 玩偶从轨道摄像机中驱逐出去。
向上空格键、向下控制键、Esc 释放键。

entries.Original:
A mirror of another player's puppet — only its originator can possess it.
Enable "Allow possessing others' puppets" in the Spawn tab to override.
entries.Translated:
另一个玩家玩偶的镜像——只有它的原创者才能拥有它。
在 “生成” 选项卡中启用 “允许拥有他人的玩偶” 以进行覆盖。

entries.Original: Search above (or Ctrl+click a Catalog row / Favourite) to select a mob, then Apply it here.
entries.Translated: 搜索上方 (或按住 Ctrl 键点击目录行/收藏夹) 选择一个 Mob，然后在此应用它。

entries.Original: Drag each axis to slide the puppet (X / Y-height / Z). Ctrl+click to type exact world coords.
entries.Translated: 拖动每个轴来滑动木偶 (X/Y-高度/Z)。Ctrl+ 点击键入精确的世界坐标。

entries.Original: Driving — WASD moves & steers this puppet. Release to place it by hand.
entries.Translated: 驾驶——WASD 移动并操控这个木偶。松开手，用手放置它。

entries.Original: Hold the puppet on a still frame (pins animation speed 0 every frame). Toggle off to resume.
entries.Translated: 将木偶固定在静止帧上 (每帧固定动画速度为 0)。切换回继续。

entries.Original:
Raise/lower where the model is DRAWN (a draw offset; the actor doesn't move).
Sink a hovering flyer to the floor, or lift a mob that spawned in the ground.
entries.Translated:
当模型为 DRAWN(绘制偏移量;Actor 不移动) 时，调高/调低。
将悬浮的飞行器沉入地面，或者举起地面上产生的暴徒。

entries.Original:
Resize this puppet (0.1x–10x). Non-monster puppets resize live;
a monster's size bakes on the next Apply (redraw).
entries.Translated:
调整这个玩偶的尺寸 (0.1 倍-10 倍)。非怪物玩偶实时调整尺寸;
一个怪物的大小将在下一个应用中烘焙 (重绘)。

entries.Original:
Toggle a weapon-drawn battle idle stance — press again to sheathe and return to
the neutral idle. (Stop clears it too.)
entries.Translated:
切换武器拔出的战斗闲置姿势——再次按下剑鞘并返回
中立的闲置状态。(停止也会清除它)

entries.Original: Play the death fall, then hold the lying dead pose. Press Stop to clear.
entries.Translated: 演奏死亡坠落，然后保持躺着的死亡姿势。按下停止键清除。

entries.Original:
Step this puppet through the standing idle-pose variants (normal idle + the three
idle_inactive clips) and hold it. Clears a held stance first, so a drawn weapon
returns to the neutral idle.
entries.Translated:
穿过这个木偶的站立空闲姿势变体 (正常空闲 + 三个
idle_inactive 夹子) 并持有。首先清除持有姿势，这样就可以拔出武器。
返回中性空闲状态。

entries.Original:
Show or hide this puppet's weapon (sheathed-on-body visibility, the /displayarms
axis). On by default. Distinct from "Draw weapon", which holds a weapon-drawn stance.
entries.Translated:
显示或隐藏这个木偶的武器 (身体可见性、/显示武器)
轴。默认打开。不同于 “抽取武器”，后者保持抽取武器的姿势。

entries.Original: (no character handle this frame, try again next frame)
entries.Translated: (没有字符处理这一帧，再试下一帧)

entries.Original: Spawn a disguised set-piece and it gets its own control row here.
entries.Translated: 产生一个经过伪装的装置，它就会在这里获得自己的控制行。

entries.Original: Type a name or family in the search box, then press Spawn.
entries.Translated: 在搜索框中键入姓名，然后按下 Spawn 键。
或者扔一个空白的假人

entries.Original: 'Spawn blank dummy' places a plain, non-targetable puppet a step ahead of you.
entries.Translated: “生出空白假人” 让一个普通的、无法瞄准的木偶先你一步出现。
伪装、摆姿势和制作动画

entries.Original: Pick the puppet in the roster below to move, rotate, resize, freeze and animate it.
entries.Translated: 从下面的名单中选择一个木偶，移动、旋转、调整大小、定格和赋予它动画效果。

entries.Original: ◆  Puppets are non-targetable set-pieces — a zone change clears them all.
entries.Translated: ◆ 玩偶是无法定位的组件——区域变化就能清除所有玩偶。

entries.Original: hidden, you're invisible now. '/hdm hide' again to show.
entries.Translated: 藏起来，你现在是隐形的。“/hdm hide” 再次展示。

entries.Original: select a mob first, or '/hdm spawn <name|BaseId>'.
entries.Translated: 先选择一个小怪，或者 “/hdm spawn <name|BaseId>”。

entries.Original: spawn failed (no local player, or the object table is full).
entries.Translated: spawn 失败 (没有本地玩家，或对象表已满)。

entries.Original: ipc dev (LOCAL mirror path, no outbound sync; use /hdm apply to disguise+sync): ver · snap · apply <name|BaseId> · revert · play <timelineId> · spawn <name|BaseId> · despawn <objIndex>. Subject = your own puppet if targeted, else you.
entries.Translated: ipc dev(LOCAL 镜像路径，无出站同步;使用/hdm app to disguise+sync):ver·snap·app <name|BaseId>·revert·play <timelineId>·spawn <name|BaseId>·despawn <objIndex>。Subject=你自己的傀儡，如果被盯上的话，否则就是你。

entries.Original: snapshot (own disguise + puppets JSON) written to /xllog.
entries.Translated: 快照 (自己的伪装 +JSON 木偶) 发送至/xllog。

entries.Original: ipc apply: no renderable match for '
ipc spawn: no renderable match for '

entries.Translated: ipc spawn → 镜像木偶 obj#
ipc spawn:原生 spawn 失败。
不是活生生的 HDM 木偶。

entries.Original: dumped animation + move-intent state to the log (/xllog → 'Anim[…]' lines).
entries.Translated: 将动画 + 移动意图状态转移到日志 (/xllog→“Anim[...]” 行)。

entries.Original:
Name inferred from the instanced encounter roster (BossMod); this base is
unnamed in the crowdsourced catalog; its home instance names its boss.
entries.Translated:
从实例化的相遇名单 (BossMod) 中推断出的名称;此基数为
众包目录中未提及;其家用实例提及其老板。

entries.Original:
Restore your real model + size and un-stick any animation, the same Revert as the
Catalog tab. ("Reset to Normal" below only clears a stuck animation; Revert
also drops the disguise.)
entries.Translated:
恢复你的真实模型 + 尺寸，并去除所有动画，与 Revert 相同。
目录选项卡。(“下方重置为正常” 仅清除卡住的动画;Return
也会去除伪装。)

entries.Original:
Log a one-shot snapshot of the animation + movement-intent state to /xllog
(BaseOverride, active timeline slots, MoveController forward-speed/heading).
Fire it while a guise is sliding or stuck-walking, then read the 'Anim[…]' lines.
entries.Translated:
将动画 + 运动意图状态的一次性快照记录到/xllog
(BaseOverride、活动时间线槽、MoveController 正向速度/头部)
在伪装滑行或僵直行走时发射它，然后阅读 “Anim[...]” 这几行。

entries.Original:
Play animations on the puppet selected in the Spawn tab's roster.
Its specials/emotes and the Common list below follow the puppet's own guise.
entries.Translated:
在 “生成” 选项卡中选择的木偶上播放动画。
它的特色/情感和下面的常见列表都遵循木偶自身的伪装。

entries.Original: Unstick: clears a frozen or stuck timeline
entries.Translated: 不粘贴：清除冻结或卡住的时间线

entries.Original:
Force the character back to a normal, unlocked idle.
Use this if an animation left it stuck ('operating a siege machine').
Safe to press anytime.
entries.Translated:
强迫角色回到正常的、未解锁的闲置状态。
如果动画卡住了 (“操作攻城机器”)，可以使用这个。
随时可以安全按下。
将播放速度重置为 1.00 倍。

entries.Original:
Raise/lower where the model is DRAWN; your character doesn't move.
Negative = down (sink a hovering gunship/boss to the ground);
positive = up (lift a mob that spawned in the floor, or stage a flyer).
Range ±20. Ctrl+click a slider to type an exact value.
entries.Translated:
当模型为 DRAWN 时上移/下移;您的角色不会移动。
负面=向下 (将悬浮的炮艇/boss 击落地面);
阳性=向上 (举起在地板上产生的暴民，或者展示一张传单)。
范围±20。按住 Control 键点击滑块以输入精确值。

entries.Original: Reset elevation to 0 (draw at the character's real height).
entries.Translated: 将仰角重置为 0(按字符的实际高度绘制)。

entries.Original:
Hold the animation on a still frame (pins speed 0 every frame).
Use it to make a boss 'stand perfectly still'. Toggle off to resume.
entries.Translated:
将动画保持在静止帧 (每帧引脚速度为 0)。
用它让老板 “完全静止不动”。切换回继续。

entries.Original: Stop any looping/one-shot animation and blend back to a normal idle.
entries.Translated: 停止任何循环/单镜头动画，混合回正常的空闲状态。

entries.Original: filter animations / emotes by name or /command…
entries.Translated: 按名称或/命令过滤动画/表情......

entries.Original:
Checked: clicking a timeline HOLDS it as a looping base pose (until you press Stop).
Unchecked: clicking plays it once, then the game blends back to idle.
entries.Translated:
确认：点击时间线并将其保持为循环基线姿势 (直到您按下停止键)。
未检查：点击播放一次，然后游戏就会恢复到空闲状态。

entries.Original:
' sequence: the intro animation once, then hold its final pose.
Press "Reset to Normal" above to release the hold.
entries.Translated:
序列：开场动画一次，然后保持最后的姿势。
按下上方的 “重置为正常” 以松开握持。

entries.Original: Disguise yourself from the Catalog to list the mob's animations here.
entries.Translated: 在目录中伪装自己，在这里列出黑帮的动画。

entries.Original:
Off: hide pure locomotion & hit-reaction rows (walk/run/swim/knockback)
that no skill triggers and your guise already animates itself.
On: show every Common timeline, including those, grouped by the chips.
entries.Translated:
关闭：隐藏纯粹的运动和碰撞反应行 (步行/跑步/游泳/击退)
没有技能触发，你的伪装就已经自动生效了。
On:显示所有公共时间线，包括那些按芯片分组的时间线。

entries.Original:
Off: show only the base-lane timelines THIS skeleton's animation files
actually define (idle/attack/dead/turn); the rest are player-body
dummies that do nothing on a monster.
On: show every Common timeline (grouped by the chips) to experiment.
entries.Translated:
关闭：仅显示基线时间线 THIS 骨架的动画文件
实际定义 (空闲/攻击/死亡/转身);其余部分是玩家身体
对怪物无能为力的傀儡。
On:显示每个通用时间线 (按芯片分组) 进行实验。

entries.Original: Click: play once, then blend back to idle.
entries.Translated: 点击：播放一次，然后混合回空闲状态。

entries.Original: Click: loop the full animation start→end (Stop to end).
entries.Translated: 点击：循环整个动画 start→end(停止到结束)。

entries.Original: Click: hold this looping pose (Stop to end). This special only renders while held.
entries.Translated: 点击：保持这个循环姿势 (停止到结束)。这个特殊功能仅在保持时进行渲染。
使用 HM-Sync 同步重音

entries.Original: HM-Sync is installed but this version doesn't expose its accent yet. Update HM-Sync. Using HDM's own accent.
entries.Translated: HM-Sync 已安装，但此版本尚未暴露其口音。更新 HM-Sync。使用 HDM 自己的口音。

entries.Original: HM-Sync not detected. Using HDM's own accent. Install HM-Sync to share its accent.
entries.Translated: 未检测到 HM-Sync。使用 HDM 自己的口音。安装 HM-Sync 以共享其口音。
使用 HDM 自己的口音。
HDM 重音 (未同步时使用)

entries.Original: Update monster names from game spawns
entries.Translated: 更新游戏衍生品中的怪物名称

entries.Original:
Off by default. When on, HDM passively samples live enemies while you're in a duty
and records their names and home instance to fill the catalog's instanced tail.
entries.Translated:
默认关闭。当开启时，HDM 会在您执勤时被动地对活生生的敌人进行采样。
并记录他们的姓名和家庭实例，以填充目录的实例化尾部。
地图变更上的明显伪装

entries.Original:
Off by default, so a disguise stays on across a zone line (walk between areas in character).
When on, your own look, scale, and elevation revert at every map change, to re-apply by hand.
Logging out always reverts either way.
entries.Translated:
默认情况下是关闭的，所以伪装会跨越一条区域线 (在角色的区域之间行走) 保持开启状态。
当开启时，你自己的外观、比例尺和海拔会随着地图的每次变化而恢复，以便手动重新应用。
注销总是以两种方式恢复。

entries.Original: Open the catalog (no arg). Subcommands: apply <name|BaseId> · spawn <name|BaseId> · despawn · revert · hide · wisp · help.
entries.Translated: 打开目录 (无参数)。子命令:app <name|BaseId>· spawn <name|BaseId>· despawn· revert· hide· wisp· help。
